notes.title: Update 1.0.14
notes.content:
Automatically turn off SSAO when in VR mode. 
Added a warning to levels that need Full Speed.
Added a warning to levels that are Extreme ( vertigo, angled surfaces, platforming).
Added fps counter to Main Menu.
Removed VR toggle when VR mode is enabled.

Work continues, more coming soon!

notes.title: Kumoon VR Deluxe Edition
notes.content:
One Robot to Rule the Boxes! 

Base game and VR Dlc : together they could be invincible!

 One Build to Bend with Both Winds 

Kumoon supports both HTC Vive and Oculus consumer versions.
Seated gamepad controls, freedom of movement, lots of intense levels, plenty of easy going levels.

 One Stomach to Handle the Levels of Large Height Differences! 

 ːHappyBotBotː VR legs not included in package!  ːHappyBotBotː
Use the speed toggle, take it easy, if you break a sweat or feel dizzy take a break.

 Base Game Requireth No Magical Helmets 
Not planning to get one of these amazing devices to strap onto your face? Enjoy the base game without the toys, no problem!

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=567214499
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=566901784

notes.title: SteamVR beta update 02
notes.content:
Work In Progress! We have found critical issues, and should have the game running properly in SteamVR at the end of February.

Launch from BigPicture mode working.
Launches directly into vr mode if Compositor is running.

No more need for beta, we are running in the main branch.

Note we are currently fighting some issues, have patience!

notes.title: SteamVR beta update 01
notes.content:
Added more debug keys in case headsets have different FOV or Aspect Ratio preferences I don't know about.

PgUp/PgDown : changes FOV
Home/End        : changes Aspect Ratio

The numbers are visible in Settings->Virtual Reality.

If your IPD is strange, the setting that has been sent by the Hmd is shown there also. IPD should always be set directly from Hmd Configuration Tools. 

( beta password 'kumoonsteamvr' )
